How to fix hydration errors

By Ana, March 2 2026

Hydration errors happen when the HTML rendered on the server does not match what React renders in the browser. This guide explains why they happen and how to fix each kind, with examples you can copy.

Reading cookies during render

Reading cookies or local storage during render is a common cause. The server has no access to them, so the two renders differ. Move the read into an effect.

useEffect(() => {
  setTheme(localStorage.getItem('theme'));
}, []);

Dates and random values

Anything that differs between two runs breaks hydration: the current time, random numbers, generated ids. Compute them once on the server and pass them down, or render them only on the client.

CauseFix
Date.now()Pass from server
Math.random()Use a seeded id
